excerpt.zh: 成功在[target.GetName]内部建立起联络之后，我们的特工现在开始建立起自己的掩护身份。目标列表现在已经缩小到十几个显要的候选人。
excerpt.en: After successfully linking up inside the [target.GetName], our operatives are now working to establish their cover identities. The target list has been narrowed down to a dozen promising candidates.
